items.description: free curriculum teaching creators, freelancers, and agencies how to monetize generative AI — the "how to sell" companion to these "what to clone" apps

Every app here is a complete, sellable SaaS product — not a demo, not a UI kit. Fork one, put your logo on it, and you have a live product that can take payments today.
You own it entirely. MIT licensed — no royalties, no revenue share. Your brand, your domain, your income.

items.title: How the money works

items.description: AI headshot tools charge $29–$49 per pack. Virtual staging tools charge $29 per image. Video clipping tools charge $49/month. These are not hypothetical — companies built on these exact ideas are doing millions in revenue. The open-source version of their product is right here.

items.title: 🚀 Quick Start

items.description: Full-stack platforms you can self-host or white-label. Leonardo AI charges $12–$60/mo. OpenArt charges $9–$57/mo. Krea charges $10–$35/mo. Freepik AI (with Magnific) runs $8–$50/mo. These open-source alternatives let you capture that same revenue with zero licensing fees.
items.title: 🌐 Open-Source AI Platforms

items.description: The market: Midjourney makes est. $200M+/year. DALL·E powers ChatGPT Plus at $20/mo for 200M+ users. Aragon AI (just headshots) reportedly crossed $1M ARR. One niche image product = real income.
items.title: 🖼️ Image Generation

items.description: The market: Opus Clip (video clipping) raised $10M and reportedly hit $20M+ ARR. Runway raised $236M. The AI video tools market is projected at $2B+ by 2027. Clipping and short-form tools are the highest-demand entry point.
items.title: 🎬 Video Generation

items.description: The market: ModiFace (acquired by L'Oreal for est. $68M) powers virtual try-ons for major retailers. YouCam makes $50M+/year. Fashion and beauty AI tools have some of the highest willingness-to-pay of any consumer vertical.
items.title: 💄 Beauty & Fashion AI

items.description: The market: Photoroom (product photo editing) raised $19M Series A and reportedly crossed $50M ARR. Flair AI raised $4M. E-commerce sellers pay premium for anything that speeds up product listings — this is a high-LTV B2B niche.
items.title: 🛒 E-commerce & Product Photography

items.description: The market: BoxBrownie (real estate photo editing) processes 100k+ orders/month at $4–$32/image. Virtual Staging AI charges $29/image. The real estate industry spends $10B+/year on marketing — AI staging is eating into that fast.
items.title: 🏠 Home & Real Estate AI

items.description: The market: Lensa AI made $50M in two months at launch. FaceApp has 150M+ users. Portrait and avatar tools are proven consumer hits — high volume, impulse purchase, low churn from novelty factor.
items.title: 👤 Portrait & Avatar AI

items.description: The market: Jasper AI hit $80M ARR at peak. Copy.ai raised $13.9M. Surfer SEO raised $22M. Writers and marketers are the highest-converting SaaS buyers — they feel the pain every day and pay monthly without question.
items.title: ✍️ Writing & Content

items.description: The market: Character.AI reportedly crossed $1B ARR. Chatbase (chatbot builder) hit $1M ARR in under a year bootstrapped. Botpress raised $25M. Custom AI agents are the fastest-growing B2B SaaS category.
items.title: 🤖 AI Agents & Chatbots

items.description: The market: ElevenLabs hit $80M ARR in under 3 years and raised at a $3.3B valuation. Murf AI raised $10M. Voice is one of the fastest paths to B2B revenue — companies pay recurring fees for voice APIs that power their own products.
items.title: 🎵 Audio & Voice
